settings.title: Help
settings.heading: Questions
settings.text: Anything not here, write to us and we answer within two working days.

settings.question: How do the sizes run?
settings.answer: Tees and hoodies are cut a little boxy. If you are between two sizes, take the smaller one. Each product page has a size chart.

settings.question: How are the prints made?
settings.answer: Printed to order on heavy cotton with water based ink, so it stays soft and does not crack in the wash.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Orders are printed and sent within three working days, tracked. Add your own delivery times here.

settings.question: Can I send it back?
settings.answer: Yes, within 30 days if it is unworn. Write to us and we send a return label.

settings.question: How do I wash it?
settings.answer: Inside out, cold, and hang it to dry. The print lasts longer that way.

settings.question: Are the stickers waterproof?
settings.answer: Yes. They are vinyl with a matte finish, fine on a bottle or a laptop.

settings.title: Printed to order
settings.text: Heavy 240 gsm cotton and water based ink. Nothing sits in a warehouse.

settings.title: Sent in three days
settings.text: Printed and posted within three working days, tracked to your door.

settings.title: Free returns
settings.text: Unworn and within 30 days? Write to us and we send a label.
